variety_description: DRR dhan45 is the first of its kind variety developed by IIRR, Hyderabad that is rich in zinc content. This biofortified medium duration, medium tall variety with long slender grain was released in 2019 for irrigated environment. Based on high zinc content and yield performance it is recommended for cultivation in Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Karnataka. Excellent cooking quality with desirable amylose content. Tolerant to major diseases and insect pests.
